name: WdInformation
description: Specifies the type of information returned about a specified selection or range.

constants.name: wdActiveEndAdjustedPageNumber
constants.description: Returns the number of the page that contains the active end of the specified selection or range. If you set a starting page number or make other manual adjustments, returns the adjusted page number (unlike wdActiveEndPageNumber).

constants.name: wdActiveEndSectionNumber
constants.description: Returns the number of the section that contains the active end of the specified selection or range.

constants.name: wdActiveEndPageNumber
constants.description: Returns the number of the page that contains the active end of the specified selection or range, counting from the beginning of the document. Any manual adjustments to page numbering are disregarded (unlike wdActiveEndAdjustedPageNumber).

constants.name: wdNumberOfPagesInDocument
constants.description: Returns the number of pages in the document associated with the selection or range.

constants.name: wdHorizontalPositionRelativeToPage
constants.description: Returns the horizontal position of the specified selection or range; this is the distance from the left edge of the selection or range to the left edge of the page measured in points (1 point = 20 twips, 72 points = 1 inch). If the selection or range isn't within the screen area, returns -1.

constants.name: wdVerticalPositionRelativeToPage
constants.description: Returns the vertical position of the selection or range; this is the distance from the top edge of the selection to the top edge of the page measured in points (1 point = 20 twips, 72 points = 1 inch). If the selection isn't visible in the document window, returns -1.

constants.name: wdHorizontalPositionRelativeToTextBoundary
constants.description: Returns the horizontal position of the specified selection or range relative to the left edge of the nearest text boundary enclosing it, in points (1 point = 20 twips, 72 points = 1 inch). If the selection or range isn't within the screen area, returns -1.

constants.name: wdVerticalPositionRelativeToTextBoundary
constants.description: Returns the vertical position of the selection or range relative to the top edge of the nearest text boundary enclosing it, in points (1 point = 20 twips, 72 points = 1 inch). This is useful for determining the position of the insertion point within a frame or table cell. If the selection isn't visible, returns -1.

constants.name: wdFirstCharacterColumnNumber
constants.description: Returns the character position of the first character in the specified selection or range. If the selection or range is collapsed, the character number immediately to the right of the range or selection is returned (this is the same as the character column number displayed in the status bar after "Col").

constants.name: wdFirstCharacterLineNumber
constants.description: Returns the character position of the first character in the specified selection or range. If the selection or range is collapsed, the character number immediately to the right of the range or selection is returned (this is the same as the character line number displayed in the status bar after "Ln").

constants.name: wdFrameIsSelected
constants.description: Returns True if the selection or range is an entire frame or text box.

constants.name: wdWithInTable
constants.description: Returns True if the selection is in a table.

constants.name: wdStartOfRangeRowNumber
constants.description: Returns the table row number that contains the beginning of the selection or range.

constants.name: wdEndOfRangeRowNumber
constants.description: Returns the table row number that contains the end of the specified selection or range.

constants.name: wdMaximumNumberOfRows
constants.description: Returns the greatest number of table rows within the table in the specified selection or range.

constants.name: wdStartOfRangeColumnNumber
constants.description: Returns the table column number that contains the beginning of the selection or range.

constants.name: wdEndOfRangeColumnNumber
constants.description: Returns the table column number that contains the end of the specified selection or range.

constants.name: wdMaximumNumberOfColumns
constants.description: Returns the greatest number of table columns within any row in the selection or range.

constants.name: wdZoomPercentage
constants.description: Returns the current percentage of magnification as set by the Percentage property.

constants.name: wdSelectionMode
constants.description: Returns a value that indicates the current selection mode, as shown in the following table.

constants.name: wdCapsLock
constants.description: Returns True if Caps Lock is in effect.

constants.name: wdNumLock
constants.description: Returns True if Num Lock is in effect.

constants.name: wdOverType
constants.description: Returns True if Overtype mode is in effect. The Overtype property can be used to change the state of the Overtype mode.

constants.name: wdRevisionMarking
constants.description: Returns True if change tracking is in effect.

constants.name: wdInFootnoteEndnotePane
constants.description: Returns True if the specified selection or range is in the footnote or endnote pane in normal view or in a footnote or endnote area in print layout view. For more information, see the descriptions of wdInFootnote and wdInEndnote in the preceding paragraphs.

constants.name: wdInCommentPane
constants.description: Returns True if the specified selection or range is in a comment pane.

constants.name: wdInHeaderFooter
constants.description: Returns True if the selection or range is in the header or footer pane or in a header or footer in print layout view.

constants.name: wdAtEndOfRowMarker
constants.description: Returns True if the specified selection or range is at the end-of-row mark in a table.

constants.name: wdReferenceOfType
constants.description: Returns a value that indicates where the selection is in relation to a footnote, endnote, or comment reference, as shown in the table in the remarks section.

constants.name: wdHeaderFooterType
constants.description: Returns a value that indicates the type of header or footer that contains the specified selection or range. See the table in the remarks section for additional information.

constants.name: wdInMasterDocument
constants.description: Returns True if the selection or range is in a master document (that is, a document that contains at least one subdocument).

constants.name: wdInFootnote
constants.description: Returns True if the specified selection or range is in a footnote area in print layout view or in the footnote pane in normal view.

constants.name: wdInEndnote
constants.description: Returns True if the specified selection or range is in an endnote area in print layout view or in the endnote pane in normal view.

constants.name: wdInWordMail
constants.description: Returns True if the selection or range is in the header or footer pane or in a header or footer in print layout view.

constants.name: wdInClipboard
constants.description: For information about this constant, consult the language reference Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

constants.name: wdInCoverPage
constants.description: Returns True if the specified selection or range is in a cover page.

constants.name: wdInBibliography
constants.description: Returns True if the specified selection or range is in a bibliography.

constants.name: wdInCitation
constants.description: Returns True if the specified selection or range is in a citation.

constants.name: wdInFieldCode
constants.description: Returns True if the specified selection or range is in a field code.

constants.name: wdInFieldResult
constants.description: Returns True if the specified selection or range is in a field result.

constants.name: wdInContentControl
constants.description: Returns True if the specified selection or range is in a content control.
